title_vi: Câu tường thuật và câu hỏi tường thuật; say và tell
theory_html:
A. Exercises in this group

A. Các bài tập trong nhóm

Exercise 127: Imagine that when you were on holiday last year you met someone famous. Look at what Anna told Ian in Exercise 126 and write an email to a friend about the conversation you had.

Bài 127: Hãy tưởng tượng năm ngoái khi đi nghỉ bạn gặp một người nổi tiếng. Xem lời Anna kể với Ian ở Bài 126 và viết email cho bạn bè về cuộc trò chuyện đó.

Exercise 128: Rewrite the sentences beginning in the way shown.

Bài 128: Viết lại câu bắt đầu như gợi ý.

Exercise 129: Complete the sentences with the correct form of say or tell.

Bài 129: Hoàn thành câu với dạng đúng của say hoặc tell.

Exercise 130: Complete the email with the correct form of say or tell.

Bài 130: Hoàn thành email với dạng đúng của say hoặc tell.

Exercise 131: There are mistakes in four of these sentences. Correct the sentences where necessary. Write ‘OK’ if the sentence is already correct.

Bài 131: Bốn trong số các câu này có lỗi. Sửa câu khi cần. Viết ‘OK’ nếu câu đã đúng.

B. Related units

B. Các unit liên quan

English Grammar in Use, Units 47–50 (theory below).

English Grammar in Use, Unit 47–50 (lý thuyết bên dưới).

mcq.question: ‘Where are you going?’ asked Tom. → Tom asked me ___.
mcq.full: ‘Where are you going?’ asked Tom. → Tom asked me where I was going.
mcq.vi: ‘Bạn đi đâu đấy?’ Tom hỏi. → Tom hỏi tôi đi đâu.
mcq.expl:
Reported questions: asked / wanted to know / wondered + question word or if / whether + subject + verb (statement word order, tense moves back, no do / did).
Câu hỏi tường thuật: asked / wanted to know / wondered + từ để hỏi hoặc if / whether + chủ ngữ + động từ (trật tự câu kể, lùi thì, không dùng do / did).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Câu hỏi tường thuật → S + V, lùi thì.
mcq.key: ‘Where are you going?’ asked Tom. → Tom asked me ___.|where I was going

mcq.question: ‘Where are you going to spend the holiday?’ asked Mike. → Mike asked me ___ the holiday.
mcq.a: where I was going to spend
mcq.b: where was I going to spend
mcq.c: where did I going to spend
mcq.full: ‘Where are you going to spend the holiday?’ asked Mike. → Mike asked me where I was going to spend the holiday.
mcq.vi: ‘Bạn định đi nghỉ ở đâu?’ Mike hỏi. → Mike hỏi tôi định đi nghỉ ở đâu.
mcq.expl:
Reported questions: asked / wanted to know / wondered + question word or if / whether + subject + verb (statement word order, tense moves back, no do / did).
Câu hỏi tường thuật: asked / wanted to know / wondered + từ để hỏi hoặc if / whether + chủ ngữ + động từ (trật tự câu kể, lùi thì, không dùng do / did).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Câu hỏi tường thuật → S + V.
mcq.key: ‘Where are you going to spend the holiday?’ asked Mike. → Mike asked me ___ the holiday.|where I was going to spend

mcq.question: ‘What will you do when you leave school?’ asked Jennifer. → Jennifer asked me ___ when I left school.
mcq.full: ‘What will you do when you leave school?’ asked Jennifer. → Jennifer asked me what I would do when I left school.
mcq.vi: ‘Ra trường bạn sẽ làm gì?’ Jennifer hỏi. → Jennifer hỏi tôi sẽ làm gì khi ra trường.
mcq.expl:
Reported questions: asked / wanted to know / wondered + question word or if / whether + subject + verb (statement word order, tense moves back, no do / did).
Câu hỏi tường thuật: asked / wanted to know / wondered + từ để hỏi hoặc if / whether + chủ ngữ + động từ (trật tự câu kể, lùi thì, không dùng do / did).
Điểm ngữ pháp: will → would; S + V.
mcq.key: ‘What will you do when you leave school?’ asked Jennifer. → Jennifer asked me ___ when I left school.|what I would do

mcq.question: ‘How did you know my name?’ the journalist asked the security guard. → The journalist wanted to know ___.
mcq.a: how the security guard knew her name
mcq.b: how did the security guard know her name
mcq.c: how the security guard did know her name
mcq.full: ‘How did you know my name?’ the journalist asked the security guard. → The journalist wanted to know how the security guard knew her name.
mcq.vi: ‘Sao anh biết tên tôi?’ nhà báo hỏi bảo vệ. → Nhà báo muốn biết bảo vệ làm sao biết tên cô.
mcq.expl:
Reported questions: asked / wanted to know / wondered + question word or if / whether + subject + verb (statement word order, tense moves back, no do / did).
Câu hỏi tường thuật: asked / wanted to know / wondered + từ để hỏi hoặc if / whether + chủ ngữ + động từ (trật tự câu kể, lùi thì, không dùng do / did).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Không dùng did trong câu hỏi tường thuật.
mcq.key: ‘How did you know my name?’ the journalist asked the security guard. → The journalist wanted to know ___.|how the security guard knew her name

mcq.question: ‘Do you have an appointment?’ asked the clerk. → The clerk asked me ___.
mcq.c: if did I have an appointment
mcq.full: ‘Do you have an appointment?’ asked the clerk. → The clerk asked me if I had an appointment.
mcq.vi: ‘Anh có hẹn trước không?’ nhân viên hỏi. → Nhân viên hỏi tôi có hẹn trước không.
mcq.expl:
Reported questions: asked / wanted to know / wondered + question word or if / whether + subject + verb (statement word order, tense moves back, no do / did).
Câu hỏi tường thuật: asked / wanted to know / wondered + từ để hỏi hoặc if / whether + chủ ngữ + động từ (trật tự câu kể, lùi thì, không dùng do / did).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Câu hỏi có / không → if / whether + S + V.
mcq.key: ‘Do you have an appointment?’ asked the clerk. → The clerk asked me ___.|if I had an appointment

mcq.question: ‘Have you seen the blue memory stick?’ Bernie asked his wife. → Bernie wondered ___ the blue memory stick.
mcq.full: ‘Have you seen the blue memory stick?’ Bernie asked his wife. → Bernie wondered whether his wife had seen the blue memory stick.
mcq.vi: ‘Em có thấy cái USB xanh không?’ Bernie hỏi vợ. → Bernie tự hỏi vợ có thấy cái USB xanh không.
mcq.expl:
Reported questions: asked / wanted to know / wondered + question word or if / whether + subject + verb (statement word order, tense moves back, no do / did).
Câu hỏi tường thuật: asked / wanted to know / wondered + từ để hỏi hoặc if / whether + chủ ngữ + động từ (trật tự câu kể, lùi thì, không dùng do / did).
Điểm ngữ pháp: whether + S + had + V3.
mcq.key: ‘Have you seen the blue memory stick?’ Bernie asked his wife. → Bernie wondered ___ the blue memory stick.|whether his wife had seen

mcq.question: ‘Why didn’t Isobel phone me?’ asked her brother. → Isobel’s brother wanted to know ___.
mcq.full: ‘Why didn’t Isobel phone me?’ asked her brother. → Isobel’s brother wanted to know why she hadn’t phoned him.
mcq.vi: ‘Sao Isobel không gọi cho anh?’ anh trai cô hỏi. → Anh trai Isobel muốn biết sao cô không gọi cho anh.
mcq.expl:
Reported questions: asked / wanted to know / wondered + question word or if / whether + subject + verb (statement word order, tense moves back, no do / did).
Câu hỏi tường thuật: asked / wanted to know / wondered + từ để hỏi hoặc if / whether + chủ ngữ + động từ (trật tự câu kể, lùi thì, không dùng do / did).
Điểm ngữ pháp: didn’t phone → hadn’t phoned; S + V.
mcq.key: ‘Why didn’t Isobel phone me?’ asked her brother. → Isobel’s brother wanted to know ___.|why she hadn’t phoned him

mcq.question: ‘Will you carry my laptop for me please, Rosie?’ Richard asked. → Richard asked Rosie ___ his laptop for him.
mcq.full: ‘Will you carry my laptop for me please, Rosie?’ Richard asked. → Richard asked Rosie whether she would carry his laptop for him.
mcq.vi: ‘Rosie, em xách laptop giúp anh nhé?’ Richard hỏi. → Richard hỏi Rosie liệu cô có xách laptop giúp anh không.
mcq.expl:
Reported questions: asked / wanted to know / wondered + question word or if / whether + subject + verb (statement word order, tense moves back, no do / did).
Câu hỏi tường thuật: asked / wanted to know / wondered + từ để hỏi hoặc if / whether + chủ ngữ + động từ (trật tự câu kể, lùi thì, không dùng do / did).
Điểm ngữ pháp: will → would; whether + S + V.
mcq.key: ‘Will you carry my laptop for me please, Rosie?’ Richard asked. → Richard asked Rosie ___ his laptop for him.|whether she would carry

mcq.question: ‘When can I see the doctor?’ Charles asked the receptionist. → Charles asked the receptionist ___ the doctor.
mcq.full: ‘When can I see the doctor?’ Charles asked the receptionist. → Charles asked the receptionist when he could see the doctor.
mcq.vi: ‘Khi nào tôi gặp được bác sĩ?’ Charles hỏi lễ tân. → Charles hỏi lễ tân khi nào anh gặp được bác sĩ.
mcq.expl:
Reported questions: asked / wanted to know / wondered + question word or if / whether + subject + verb (statement word order, tense moves back, no do / did).
Câu hỏi tường thuật: asked / wanted to know / wondered + từ để hỏi hoặc if / whether + chủ ngữ + động từ (trật tự câu kể, lùi thì, không dùng do / did).
Điểm ngữ pháp: can → could; S + V.
mcq.key: ‘When can I see the doctor?’ Charles asked the receptionist. → Charles asked the receptionist ___ the doctor.|when he could see

mcq.question: ___ your brother the truth about that money?
mcq.full: Did you tell your brother the truth about that money?
mcq.vi: Bạn có nói thật với em trai về số tiền đó không?
mcq.expl:
tell somebody (something), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say something (to somebody), say anything / what to say.
tell + người (+ điều gì), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say + điều gì (+ to + người), say anything / what to say.
Điểm ngữ pháp: tell + người + the truth.
mcq.key: ___ your brother the truth about that money?|Did you tell

mcq.question: What ___ to Wendy last night? She looks terribly upset this morning.
mcq.full: What did you say to Wendy last night? She looks terribly upset this morning.
mcq.vi: Tối qua bạn đã nói gì với Wendy? Sáng nay trông cô ấy buồn kinh khủng.
mcq.expl:
tell somebody (something), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say something (to somebody), say anything / what to say.
tell + người (+ điều gì), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say + điều gì (+ to + người), say anything / what to say.
Điểm ngữ pháp: say something to somebody.
mcq.key: What ___ to Wendy last night? She looks terribly upset this morning.|did you say

mcq.question: Is something wrong? Can you ___ me about it?
mcq.full: Is something wrong? Can you tell me about it?
mcq.vi: Có chuyện gì à? Bạn kể cho tôi nghe được không?
mcq.expl:
tell somebody (something), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say something (to somebody), say anything / what to say.
tell + người (+ điều gì), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say + điều gì (+ to + người), say anything / what to say.
Điểm ngữ pháp: tell + người + about.
mcq.key: Is something wrong? Can you ___ me about it?|tell

mcq.question: My English teacher keeps asking me ___ the class a joke from my country.
mcq.full: My English teacher keeps asking me to tell the class a joke from my country.
mcq.vi: Cô giáo tiếng Anh cứ bảo tôi kể cho cả lớp một chuyện cười ở nước tôi.
mcq.expl:
tell somebody (something), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say something (to somebody), say anything / what to say.
tell + người (+ điều gì), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say + điều gì (+ to + người), say anything / what to say.
Điểm ngữ pháp: ask + O + to V; tell a joke.
mcq.key: My English teacher keeps asking me ___ the class a joke from my country.|to tell

mcq.question: If I asked you to marry me, what ___?
mcq.full: If I asked you to marry me, what would you say?
mcq.vi: Nếu anh hỏi cưới em, em sẽ nói gì?
mcq.expl:
tell somebody (something), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say something (to somebody), say anything / what to say.
tell + người (+ điều gì), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say + điều gì (+ to + người), say anything / what to say.
Điểm ngữ pháp: say something; would (điều kiện loại 2).
mcq.key: If I asked you to marry me, what ___?|would you say

mcq.question: I never know what ___ to people when they pay me a compliment.
mcq.full: I never know what to say to people when they pay me a compliment.
mcq.vi: Tôi chẳng bao giờ biết nói gì khi người ta khen mình.
mcq.expl:
tell somebody (something), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say something (to somebody), say anything / what to say.
tell + người (+ điều gì), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say + điều gì (+ to + người), say anything / what to say.
Điểm ngữ pháp: what to say (to somebody).
mcq.key: I never know what ___ to people when they pay me a compliment.|to say

mcq.question: Don’t worry, I’m sure the boys are fine. Anyway, I ___ them to call me if they had any problems.
mcq.full: Don’t worry, I’m sure the boys are fine. Anyway, I told them to call me if they had any problems.
mcq.vi: Đừng lo, chắc bọn trẻ ổn. Dù sao tôi đã bảo chúng gọi cho tôi nếu có chuyện.
mcq.expl:
tell somebody (something), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say something (to somebody), say anything / what to say.
tell + người (+ điều gì), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say + điều gì (+ to + người), say anything / what to say.
Điểm ngữ pháp: tell + người + to V.
mcq.key: Don’t worry, I’m sure the boys are fine. Anyway, I ___ them to call me if they had any problems.|told

mcq.question: I’ll never speak to him again after all the lies he ___ me last weekend.
mcq.full: I’ll never speak to him again after all the lies he told me last weekend.
mcq.vi: Tôi sẽ không bao giờ nói chuyện với anh ta nữa sau bao lời dối trá anh ta nói với tôi cuối tuần trước.
mcq.expl:
tell somebody (something), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say something (to somebody), say anything / what to say.
tell + người (+ điều gì), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say + điều gì (+ to + người), say anything / what to say.
Điểm ngữ pháp: tell lies / tell somebody lies.
mcq.key: I’ll never speak to him again after all the lies he ___ me last weekend.|told

mcq.question: If I were you, I ___ anything about your problems now.
mcq.full: If I were you, I wouldn’t say anything about your problems now.
mcq.vi: Nếu tôi là bạn, tôi sẽ không nói gì về vấn đề của bạn lúc này.
mcq.expl:
tell somebody (something), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say something (to somebody), say anything / what to say.
tell + người (+ điều gì), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say + điều gì (+ to + người), say anything / what to say.
Điểm ngữ pháp: say anything (không có tân ngữ người).
mcq.key: If I were you, I ___ anything about your problems now.|wouldn’t say

mcq.question: Promise you ___ anything to my girlfriend. She’ll be furious if she finds out what I’ve done.
mcq.full: Promise you won’t say anything to my girlfriend. She’ll be furious if she finds out what I’ve done.
mcq.vi: Hứa là bạn sẽ không nói gì với bạn gái tôi nhé. Cô ấy sẽ điên lên nếu biết tôi đã làm gì.
mcq.expl:
tell somebody (something), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say something (to somebody), say anything / what to say.
tell + người (+ điều gì), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say + điều gì (+ to + người), say anything / what to say.
Điểm ngữ pháp: say anything to somebody.
mcq.key: Promise you ___ anything to my girlfriend. She’ll be furious if she finds out what I’ve done.|won’t say

mcq.question: I ___ you, I don’t know where your phone is.
mcq.full: I’ve already told you, I don’t know where your phone is.
mcq.vi: Tôi đã bảo bạn rồi, tôi không biết điện thoại bạn ở đâu.
mcq.expl:
tell somebody (something), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say something (to somebody), say anything / what to say.
tell + người (+ điều gì), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say + điều gì (+ to + người), say anything / what to say.
Điểm ngữ pháp: tell + người.
mcq.key: I ___ you, I don’t know where your phone is.|’ve already told

mcq.question: I’m ready to serve the meal. Can you ___ the children to go and wash their hands, please?
mcq.full: I’m ready to serve the meal. Can you tell the children to go and wash their hands, please?
mcq.vi: Tôi dọn cơm đây. Bạn bảo bọn trẻ đi rửa tay được không?
mcq.expl:
tell somebody (something), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say something (to somebody), say anything / what to say.
tell + người (+ điều gì), tell the truth / a joke / lies; say + điều gì (+ to + người), say anything / what to say.
Điểm ngữ pháp: tell + người + to V.
mcq.key: I’m ready to serve the meal. Can you ___ the children to go and wash their hands, please?|tell

mcq.question: We talked for hours and I ___ him all about the plans we’ve made for our business.
mcq.full: We talked for hours and I told him all about the plans we’ve made for our business.
mcq.vi: Chúng tớ nói chuyện hàng giờ và tớ kể cho bố nghe tất cả kế hoạch kinh doanh của bọn mình.
mcq.expl:
tell + person (told him all about …, told him that …); say (that) … / say to somebody; asked me to tell him.
tell + người (told him all about …, told him that …); say (that) … / say to + người; asked me to tell him.
Điểm ngữ pháp: tell + người + about.
mcq.key: We talked for hours and I ___ him all about the plans we’ve made for our business.|told

mcq.question: At first, he wasn’t very interested and he ___ he didn’t think we were old enough to run a business.
mcq.full: At first, he wasn’t very interested and he said he didn’t think we were old enough to run a business.
mcq.vi: Lúc đầu bố không mấy quan tâm và nói rằng không nghĩ bọn mình đủ lớn để kinh doanh.
mcq.expl:
tell + person (told him all about …, told him that …); say (that) … / say to somebody; asked me to tell him.
tell + người (told him all about …, told him that …); say (that) … / say to + người; asked me to tell him.
Điểm ngữ pháp: say (that) … (không có tân ngữ người).
mcq.key: At first, he wasn’t very interested and he ___ he didn’t think we were old enough to run a business.|said

mcq.question: But then I ___ him that we had already talked to a small business adviser.
mcq.full: But then I told him that we had already talked to a small business adviser.
mcq.vi: Nhưng rồi tớ nói với bố là bọn mình đã gặp chuyên gia tư vấn doanh nghiệp nhỏ.
mcq.expl:
tell + person (told him all about …, told him that …); say (that) … / say to somebody; asked me to tell him.
tell + người (told him all about …, told him that …); say (that) … / say to + người; asked me to tell him.
Điểm ngữ pháp: tell + người + that.
mcq.key: But then I ___ him that we had already talked to a small business adviser.|told

mcq.question: … and she ___ that the plan seemed realistic.
mcq.full: … and she had said that the plan seemed realistic.
mcq.vi: … và cô ấy đã nói rằng kế hoạch có vẻ khả thi.
mcq.expl:
tell + person (told him all about …, told him that …); say (that) … / say to somebody; asked me to tell him.
tell + người (told him all about …, told him that …); say (that) … / say to + người; asked me to tell him.
Điểm ngữ pháp: say that; had said (trước thời điểm kể).
mcq.key: … and she ___ that the plan seemed realistic.|had said

mcq.question: So after that he sat down and asked me ___ him exactly how much money we’d need to start with.
mcq.full: So after that he sat down and asked me to tell him exactly how much money we’d need to start with.
mcq.vi: Thế là bố ngồi xuống và bảo tớ nói chính xác cần bao nhiêu tiền để bắt đầu.
mcq.expl:
tell + person (told him all about …, told him that …); say (that) … / say to somebody; asked me to tell him.
tell + người (told him all about …, told him that …); say (that) … / say to + người; asked me to tell him.
Điểm ngữ pháp: ask + O + to V; tell + người.
mcq.key: So after that he sat down and asked me ___ him exactly how much money we’d need to start with.|to tell

mcq.question: Eventually he ___ to me, ‘OK, I think it’s a good plan.’
mcq.full: Eventually he said to me, ‘OK, I think it’s a good plan.’
mcq.vi: Cuối cùng bố nói với tớ: ‘Được, bố nghĩ đó là kế hoạch tốt.’
mcq.expl:
tell + person (told him all about …, told him that …); say (that) … / say to somebody; asked me to tell him.
tell + người (told him all about …, told him that …); say (that) … / say to + người; asked me to tell him.
Điểm ngữ pháp: say to somebody.
mcq.key: Eventually he ___ to me, ‘OK, I think it’s a good plan.’|said

mcq.question: ‘___ Stephanie that I’ll lend you the money to get started.’
mcq.full: ‘Tell Stephanie that I’ll lend you the money to get started.’
mcq.vi: ‘Con nói với Stephanie là bố sẽ cho các con vay tiền để khởi nghiệp.’
mcq.expl:
tell + person (told him all about …, told him that …); say (that) … / say to somebody; asked me to tell him.
tell + người (told him all about …, told him that …); say (that) … / say to + người; asked me to tell him.
Điểm ngữ pháp: tell + người + that.
mcq.key: ‘___ Stephanie that I’ll lend you the money to get started.’|Tell

mcq.question: Jen ___ very happy and liked her new boss better than her old one.
mcq.full: Jen said she was very happy and liked her new boss better than her old one.
mcq.vi: Jen nói cô ấy rất vui và thích sếp mới hơn sếp cũ.
mcq.expl:
tell needs a person object (told us that …); say has no person object (said that …); ask somebody not to do; past tense may stay unchanged for facts still true.
tell cần tân ngữ chỉ người (told us that …); say không có tân ngữ chỉ người (said that …); ask somebody not to do; thì có thể giữ nguyên khi sự việc vẫn đúng.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Hiện tại → was (không dùng had been).
mcq.key: Jen ___ very happy and liked her new boss better than her old one.|said she was

mcq.question: We had a great evening with Janet. She was ___ about her fascinating trip to Kenya.
mcq.full: We had a great evening with Janet. She was telling us about her fascinating trip to Kenya.
mcq.vi: Chúng tôi có buổi tối tuyệt vời với Janet. Cô ấy kể cho chúng tôi nghe về chuyến đi Kenya thú vị.
mcq.expl:
tell needs a person object (told us that …); say has no person object (said that …); ask somebody not to do; past tense may stay unchanged for facts still true.
tell cần tân ngữ chỉ người (told us that …); say không có tân ngữ chỉ người (said that …); ask somebody not to do; thì có thể giữ nguyên khi sự việc vẫn đúng.
Điểm ngữ pháp: tell + người; không dùng say + người.
mcq.key: We had a great evening with Janet. She was ___ about her fascinating trip to Kenya.|telling us

Điểm ngữ pháp: tell + người + that.
mcq.key: We were disappointed when the receptionist ___ the hotel was fully booked that week.|told us that
